taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-14 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 161.1 | 3.39 | 3.39
2 | 1022.2 | 1.76 | 5.15
3 | 85.2 | 1.93 | 7.08
4 | 88.8 | 9.77 | 16.85
5 | 117.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-14
Curve type: KHA
Aquifer depth: 5.15 m – 16.85 m
Recommendation: The low-resistivity zone comprising layers 3 and 4 (85–89 ohm-m, 5.15–16.85 m depth) is interpreted as the main water-bearing horizon; drill through the overlying resistive layer 2 (1022 ohm-m) with casing to prevent collapse, then screen the interval from approximately 5.15 m to 16.85 m to target this aquifer.
